author: Robert Miller
text:
Lots of sensors have had problems. 
Sometimes it's user error and sometimes it's quality control issues.
Cgm is a continuously evolving industry and in time I'm sure the issues will get worked out.
But for people to continuously rush forward and everytime blame the user is nonsense.
Get over yourselves.. even Abbott admitted they had a run of bad sensors from one of many production lines.
I would say at present it's probably 40% user error and 60% defective product. 
It's gotten better and in time I'm sure it will continue to get better and if not than people will stop using it and they will go under.
Only time will tell.
